description: A slew limiter whose rise and fall take a set time whatever the distance between voltages, in 2HP; with nothing patched in it free-runs as an LFO

params.text: Sets how long a rise takes, 1ms to 10 seconds; with 'Duration/Slew knobs' ticked it sets both the rise and the fall together
Sets how long a fall takes, 1ms to 10 seconds; with 'Duration/Slew knobs' ticked it sets the balance between rise and fall instead, centred meaning equal
Bends the slew between logarithmic, linear and exponential
Mirrors the fall curve so it matches the rise on screen

inputs.text: Lengthens the rise by one second per volt, added to the ATT knob and floored at 1ms
Lengthens the fall by one second per volt, added to the DEC knob and floored at 1ms
Bends the curve, added to the SHP knob
The signal to be slewed; with nothing patched the module free-runs as an LFO

menu: Duration/Slew knobs — turns the two time knobs into a total duration on ATT and a rise-to-fall balance on DEC, centred meaning equal
